title: Throne of Trials
description:
🔷 No Single Strategy Wins Every Battle

Adapt your strategy for every foe, rebuild your party, predict enemy moves, and discover the ultimate solution.

This is a turn-based, boss-focused RPG dedicated purely to the thrill of overcoming challenging encounters.
Combine 15 distinct characters with a vast array of equipment and skills to forge your own unique builds.

Will you achieve victory through precise tactics—reading the enemy's every move to win against all odds?
Or through sheer build power—collecting loot and overwhelming foes with devastating synergies?

Sharpen your tactics or hone your builds. There is no single way to overcome the trials.

🔷 Craft the Optimal Party for Every Boss

Every boss possesses unique traits and mechanics.

• Against one, tanking and threat/hate management are vital.

• Against another, hit rate and Break focus are required.

• Against another, all-out firepower is the only way forward.

The same party setup will not carry you through every fight.
Select 4 characters from a pool of 15, and freely combine:

• 5 Active Skills

• 4 Passive Skills

• Counter Skills

• Equipment

Craft the perfect counter-strategy for every unique threat.
(Quality-of-life features like Auto-Equip and Party Presets are also fully supported.)

🔷 Read Enemy Intentions and Seize Control

Victory isn't decided by raw stats alone.

Manage threat to direct incoming blows toward your tank.
Utilize Breaks to interrupt devastating ultimate attacks.
And experience the game's signature feature—Intercept Order, allowing you to interrupt enemy turns.

Anticipate enemy actions. Predict correctly, and you'll act before the boss moves.
Inflict critical hits, trigger bonus damage, or trigger a Break to completely shut down dangerous enemy actions before they land.

Reading your enemy is your ultimate weapon.

🔷 Every Item and Skill Spawns New Strategies

Defeat bosses to earn gear with random bonus effects and powerful passive skills.

New loot offers much more than simple stat increases:

• Critical-focused builds

• Low-HP, high-risk/high-reward berserker builds

• Break-specialized builds

When gear changes, your whole tactical approach transforms.
Salvage unwanted gear into Ether to upgrade your stats or craft new equipment.

🔷 Every Boss Rules by Different Laws

• A boss that manipulates the weather itself.

• A boss that records incoming damage to unleash devastating counterattacks.

• Twin bosses requiring precise HP balancing.

• A boss whose behavior shifts with the tilting of a balance scale.

A build or strategy that brought you victory once will not guarantee success in the next fight.
Analyze enemy mechanics, adapt your builds, and conquer every encounter through trial and triumph.

🔷 Ultimate Challenges Await in the Endgame

Late in the game, face Trial of the Oracle—a pinnacle endgame mode designed to test every shred of your tactical knowledge.

Scaling up to Level 10 difficulty, this gauntlet pits you against former bosses unleashing lethal new mechanics and gimmicks.
Every build you've forged and every strategy you've learned will be put to the ultimate test.
description_short: Crush mighty bosses with finely honed builds in this turn-based RPG. Each enemy presents unique mechanics. Combine 15 characters, gear, and passives to forge your ultimate strategy. Clever tactics with Intercept Order, or raw build power? Overcome every trial your way!
